official_identity: The current Indian Health Service Rosebud Service Unit page identifies Rosebud hospital/PHS Indian Hospital in Rosebud, South Dakota and describes its comprehensive medical and surgical hospital services.
regulatory_observation: 45 CFR 180.30 deems federally owned or operated hospitals, including hospitals operated by an Indian Health Program, in compliance with Part 180.
interpretation: CMS ownership and city/state/ZIP agreement with the current IHS hospital page support the federal scope disposition. The page supplies the PO Box and hospital description in addition to CMS's street address. This is not a claim about MRF availability or file quality.
next_action: Retain the federal scope exclusion unless CMS ownership or regulatory scope changes.
